main.description: The user's Placita profile. One record per repo, key 'self'. Holds the home location the profile map centers on. City level by design, no street addresses; access control arrives with Spaces.

location.description: Where the user is based. Stored as the shared community.lexicon.location.geo type so any other Atmosphere app can read it.

createdAt.description: When the profile record was first written.

updatedAt.description: When the profile record was last written.
